capabilities: Block typing once a note reaches its character limit
Show remaining characters in the status bar
Cut pasted or dropped text to the available room
Set a per-note limit with the char-limit property
Restrict or exclude folders from the limit
disambiguation: Not a lightweight theme or performance plugin; it caps how many characters a note can hold.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The status-bar counter is not visible on phones because Obsidian hides the status bar there, but the limit is still enforced. Notes already over the limit are not truncated, and changes written from outside the editor are never blocked.
motivation: Inspired by tweets: a ceiling makes you think a little harder about what to write.
problem: Obsidian has no way to cap how long a note can grow, so nothing stops a note from passing a length you want to keep.

relations.evidence: Thanks to orl0pl, whose fork suggested excluded folders.

summary: Enforces a hard character limit on notes, with a live status-bar counter and paste trimming.
